results.reply:
🚨 **Agar aap abhi khatre mein hain to 112 call karein.** Agar khud ko nuksaan pahunchane ke khayal aa rahe hain to **Tele-MANAS 14416** par call karein (free, 24×7). Aap akele nahi hain.

Dost, sabse pehle meri baat suniye—aapki life bahut keemti hai. Salary ka issue solve ho sakta hai, par aapka hona zaroori hai. Please abhi ke abhi 14416 (Tele-MANAS) par call kijiye, wahan trained counsellors aapki baat sunenge aur aapko support karenge. Akele mat rahiye.

**Your legal position:**
Salary na milna ek serious matter hai aur law aapke saath hai. Code on Wages, 2019 ke under, employer ki zimmedari hai ki woh aapko time par salary de. 4 mahine ka delay kafi zyada hai, aur aapke paas legal raste hain apna paisa recover karne ke.

**Law you can cite:**
* **Code on Wages, 2019 (Section 17):** Salary har mahine ki 7th date tak mil jani chahiye; iska matlab hai ki aapka employer rule tod raha hai.
* **Code on Wages, 2019 (Section 45):** Aap labour authority ke paas claim file kar sakte hain agar salary nahi mil rahi hai. Yeh authority aapka paisa dilwane mein madad karti hai.

**What to do now:**
1. **Call 14416 (Tele-MANAS):** Yeh free mental health helpline hai, please abhi baat kijiye.
2. **Written Request:** Apne employer/HR ko ek formal email bhejiye jisme saaf likha ho ki kitne mahine ki salary pending hai. Iska record sambhaal kar rakhein.
3. **SAMADHAN Portal:** Agar email ka jawab na aaye, toh https://samadhan.labour.gov.in par apni complaint register karein.

**I need from you:**
1. Kya aapke paas employment ka koi proof hai (jaise offer letter, payslips, ya bank statement)?
2. Aapki company ka naam kya hai?

citations.title: Deadline for paying wages, including after leaving the job
citations.plain: Wages are due by these deadlines: daily workers at the end of the shift; weekly workers on the last working day of the week; fortnightly workers before the end of the second day after the fortnight; monthly workers before the end of the 7th day of the next month. If you are removed, dismissed, retrenched or resign, or lose your job because the establishment closes, your wages must be paid within two working days.

citations.title: Filing a wage claim: who decides it and the 3-year limit
citations.plain: Wage claims under the Code are heard by an authority the Government appoints, who must be at least a Gazetted Officer. The claim can be filed by you, your registered trade union, or an Inspector-cum-Facilitator. File within 3 years of the date the claim arises; a later claim may still be accepted if you show sufficient cause. Besides the amount due, the authority can award compensation of up to ten times the claim, and it tries to decide within three months.

citations.act: Tele-MANAS (Ministry of Health and Family Welfare)
citations.title: National Tele Mental Health helpline 14416
citations.plain: Tele-MANAS is a free, 24x7 government mental-health helpline. Call 14416 or 1-800-891-4416 to talk to a trained counsellor in your language.
